verdict.rationale: GitLab's CI/CD is inherently headless/automatable, and its REST API, CLI, and OAuth/token-based authentication (gitlab-docs-10, gitlab-docs-12, gitlab-docs-17, gitlab-probe-3) allow full programmatic/non-interactive control of pipelines and workflows, explicitly marketed for automating workflows and integrations. Docs also describe agents executing within CI/CD lifecycle stages under orchestration (gitlab-docs-24), reinforcing headless automation support. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of running GitLab CI purely headlessly in third-party automation contexts, and more detail on non-interactive agent/bot execution specifics.
